articles.title: Pif1 family helicases suppress genome instability at G-quadruplex motifs

sentences.sentence: The Saccharomyces cerevisiae Pif1 helicase is the prototypical member of the Pif1 DNA helicase family, which is conserved from bacteria to humans.
Here we show that exceptionally potent G-quadruplex unwinding is conserved among Pif1 helicases.
Moreover, Pif1 helicases from organisms separated by more than 3 billion years of evolution suppressed DNA damage at G-quadruplex motifs in yeast.
The G-quadruplex-induced damage generated in the absence of Pif1 helicases led to new genetic and epigenetic changes.
Furthermore, when expressed in yeast, human PIF1 suppressed both G-quadruplex-associated DNA damage and telomere lengthening.
